name: Concors: Agent Orchestrator
subtitle: Code, agents and terminals
description:
Keep your coding workspace close with Concors. Follow coding agents, review their requests, and continue work on a compatible connected computer or server from your iPhone.

FOLLOW YOUR AGENTS
Read conversations, follow progress, review tool requests, and send messages to your coding agents.

CONTINUE YOUR WORKSPACE
Switch between workspaces and tabs. Browse project files, read Markdown, inspect code, and save edits. Continue terminal sessions on your connected machine.

STAY IN SYNC
Your agents and terminal sessions run on the connected machine and can keep working when you leave the app. Return to your workspace from your phone.

An account and a compatible connected machine are required. AI features may require separate provider accounts and are subject to those providers' availability and terms. Commands run on the connected machine; AI requests use its configured providers. Review generated output and tool requests before acting on them.

Concors is free at launch. Add your machine using the desktop app before connecting to it from your iPhone.
promotionalText: Follow coding agents, review tool requests and continue your workspace from iPhone. Add a compatible machine from the desktop app to get started.
reviewNotes: Launch is free. Users add machines from the desktop app; iPhone users connect to machines already on their account. Settings > Account contains AI-sharing permission controls, private content/problem reporting, and permanent account deletion with same-user reauthentication and a private status receipt. Concors is a native client for coding workspaces and agents on authorized computers. It has no public social feed, user-to-user messaging, embedded general-purpose browser, or app marketplace. External web links require confirmation and open the system browser.
